newsitem.title: UK: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to May 23.
newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to May 23.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - to May 23
The following is a four-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.
MONDAY, APRIL 28
MONTREUX, Switzerland - International Electronic Cinema Festival. Awards ceremony emceed by Sir Peter Ustinov. (final day of six-day festival).
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 30
BERLIN - Annual news conference of trade fair monitoring company Gesellschaft zur freiwilligen Kontrolle von Messe- und Ausstellungszahlen FKM. 0900 GMT.
FRIDAY, MAY 2
LONDON - RAJAR (Radio Joint Audience Research Ltd) presents quarterly results on UK radio market. 1100 GMT, Institute of Practitioners in Advertising, 44 Belgrave Square. Contact: (44) 171 584 3303
SUNDAY, MAY 4
STUTTGART, Germany - Multimedia Market, organised by Messe Stuttgart International. Contact: (49) 711 25 89224
TUESDAY, MAY 6

LONDON - Launch of Advertising Association's publication "Does Advertising Affect Market Size?" at IPA, 44 Belgrave Square, London SW1. Contact: Arabella Price (44) 171 828 2771, fax (44) 171 931 0376, email advert@dial.pipex.com.
THURSDAY, MAY 15
LONDON - Digital and the Future of Radio & Audio: Where Next for Audio & Radio Data Services? Cafe Royal. Contact: (44) 171 453 2700 or (44) 171 637 4383. (first day of two-day conference)
FRIDAY, MAY 16
LONDON - Digital and the Future of Radio & Audio: Where Next for Audio & Radio Data Services? Cafe Royal. (second day of two-day conference)
MONDAY, MAY 19
LONDON - Marjorie Scardino, chief executive of Pearson Plc, addresses Advertising Association's Annual General Meeting luncheon. Savoy Hotel. Contact: Arabella Price (44) 171 828 2771
TUESDAY, MAY 20
LONDON - Internet World UK-Spring 97, National Hall and Conference Centre, Olympia. Contact: (44) 1865 388000 or www.iwuk.com (first day of three-day conference)
LONDON - A New Century in Publishing, Financial Times Conference. Contact: (44) 171 896 2626. (first day of two-day conference)
LONDON - The Creative Show conference, Business Design Centre, Islington, London N1. Contact: (44) 171 287 5678, fax (44) 171 287 0710. (first day of three-day conference)
WEDNESDAY, MAY 21
LONDON - Internet World UK-Spring 97, (second day of three-day conference)
LONDON - A New Century in Publishing, Financial Times Conference. (second day of two-day conference)
LONDON - Youth Perspective 2, annual youth marketing conference. 0830 -1600 GMT, Ministry of Sound, London SE1. Contact: (44) 171 413 4486
LONDON - The Creative Show conference, Business Design Centre, Islington, London N1 (second day of three-day conference)
THURSDAY, MAY 22
LONDON - Internet World UK-Spring 97 (final day of three-day conference)
LONDON - The European Strategy Summit: Digital Terrestrial Television. Marriott Hotel, Grosvenor Square. Contact: (44) 171 453 2700. (first day of two-day conference)
LONDON - Intranets: Key Issues for the Employee Communicator. New Connaught Rooms, 61-65 Queen Street. Contact: (44) 171 405 7811

STOCKHOLM - World Federation of Advertiser's annual general meeting and seminar on Commercial Communications & Self-Regulation in the Baltic Region. Contact: (32) 2 502 5740 (first day of two-day meeting)
LONDON - The Creative Show conference, Business Design Centre, Islington, London N1 (final day of three-day conference)
FRIDAY, MAY 23
LONDON - The European Strategy Summitt: Digital Terrestrial Television. Marriott Hotel, Grosvenor Square. (final day of two-day conference)

STOCKHOLM - World Federation of Advertiser's annual general meeting and seminar on Commercial Communications & Self-Regulation in the Baltic Region. Contact: (32) 2 502 5740 (second day of two-day meeting)
